page.layout: One printed page framed by a decorative woodcut border; running head and page number at the top; one column of text in the centre. Left edge shows part of the facing page (neighbouring page edge with partial text, not transcribed).

main_text.p: Marchia Trevisana redeamus, qui in secunda parte sui libri in haec verba expresse scribit: Cum damno (inquiens) Expertus sum, QUOD IN METALLIS ABDITUM ESSE OPORTEAT: Quo allegat dictum illud Gebri dicentis: Nulla res extranea, quae non ex metallis composita, seu orta, potens est ipsa perficere, seu eorum transmutationem facere novam. A tvero idem Bernhardus Corpora perfecta (inquit) quae sic simpliciter per naturam sunt perfecta, tantum in gradu suo simplici sunt perfecta, & nisi per artem plusquam perfecta fiant, non possunt imperfectis corporibus hoc modo ullum auxilium praestare: sed si per artem tractentur (inquit) & secundum artem more Philosophico perficiantur (notentur verba) tunc via aperta

page.notes: Printed text transcribed with the printer's spelling. The last word "ta" is the catchword-like continuation set at the right below the final line; treated as a line of text. Some words are slightly uncertain due to the faint scan, notably "tvero" and "Bernhardus", which appear as printed. Left margin contains part of the facing page, not transcribed.
